objections.title: AC3 verification command `git diff 84fa15d5 HEAD -- <path>` ignores working-tree-only changes
objections.what_ba_said: AC3 (lines 187-190): 'WHEN compared against git show 84fa15d5:packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx THEN git diff 84fa15d5 HEAD -- packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx returns no output (byte-identical)'. Verification command (lines 238-239): 'git diff 84fa15d5 HEAD -- packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx → must be empty'.
objections.why_objected: If dev writes the file via Write tool but does not commit, `git diff 84fa15d5 HEAD -- <path>` compares the upstream blob to the OLD HEAD's broken file — which will show large diff (the very ContextMenu→DropdownMenu migration). This means AC3 as written FAILS during the dev-write phase even after a perfect fix. The correct pre-commit verification command is `git show 84fa15d5:<path> | diff - <path>` or `diff <(git show 84fa15d5:<path>) <path>` or `git diff 84fa15d5 -- <path>` (no HEAD ref). Post-commit, the BA's command works. This is a small but real verification-execution drift that would slow down dev iteration by triggering false-fail on the AC3 check.
objections.evidence: Standard git semantics: `git diff <commit> HEAD -- <path>` compares the commit's blob to HEAD's blob; working-tree changes are not included. To compare upstream blob against working-tree, use `git diff <commit> -- <path>` (no HEAD), or read working-tree file directly.
objections.remediation: BA must split AC3 verification into two phases: (a) pre-commit: `diff <(git show 84fa15d5:packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx) packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx` returns empty; (b) post-commit: `git diff 84fa15d5 HEAD -- packages/happy-app/sources/components/SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx` returns empty. Or simpler: use `git diff 84fa15d5 -- <path>` (no HEAD) which compares upstream blob to working tree directly, works in both phases.

AC3 (lines 197-203 of ticket-20260509-115500.md iter-2) reworded to working-tree-aware forms: `diff <(git show 84fa15d5:<path>) <path>` OR `git diff 84fa15d5 -- <path>` (no HEAD). objections.title: Post-commit verification forms (HEAD~1 HEAD, git diff HEAD) break if dev makes more than one commit
objections.what_ba_said: AC2 offers `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- ...` as the post-commit equivalent. AC10 uses `git diff HEAD -- ...` post-commit.
objections.why_objected: HEAD~1 HEAD only inspects the LAST commit. If dev makes 2 commits during the cycle (one for the file write, one for an unrelated 'cleanup'), HEAD~1 HEAD misses the earlier commit and would falsely pass AC2. Same weakness for AC10's `git diff HEAD -- ...` post-commit — once dev commits a dep change, HEAD = post-change-commit and the diff is empty, falsely passing AC10. Pre-commit forms work correctly; the spec's post-commit alternates are weaker than the pre-commit forms they claim to be equivalent to.
objections.evidence: Logical analysis of git semantics. Codex iteration-2 adversarial review independently flagged this.
objections.remediation: Either (a) DROP the post-commit alternate forms from AC2 + AC10 entirely and require pre-commit verification only (since QA always runs pre-dev-commit anyway), OR (b) replace HEAD~1 HEAD with a fixed pre-cycle base SHA (e.g., the merge-base with origin/main, or the SHA pinned in `git_rationale.root_cause_commit`). Suggested form: `git diff --name-only ff51184e..HEAD -- 'packages/' '.github/workflows/'` for AC2, and `git diff ff51184e..HEAD -- <dep paths>` for AC10.

additional_observations_not_blocking.title: AC3 working-tree-aware form is silent on staged-index state
additional_observations_not_blocking.finding: `diff <(git show 84fa15d5:<path>) <path>` compares blob to working-tree file but ignores the staging index. If dev stages a wrong version of the file, then corrects only the worktree (without re-staging), AC3 passes the worktree check while the staged commit-to-be is still wrong. Edge case; unlikely with single-file edit but worth noting.
additional_observations_not_blocking.fix_suggestion: Add a third optional form for AC3: `git diff --cached 84fa15d5 -- <path>` returns empty (verifies staged content matches blob). Or instruct QA to verify in this order: (1) worktree diff, (2) `git status` confirms file is staged, (3) `git diff --cached HEAD -- <path>` shows the upstream-blob content as the staged change.
